items.title: The first direct Mac release
items.description: Download the signed, notarized Mac app, start a seven-day trial, or activate an existing license.

items.title: A Mac App Store edition
items.description: Bring Trayage to the Mac App Store with purchases and restores through your Apple Account.

items.title: Keep the review up to date
items.description: Notice changes in the selected folder so new downloads can appear without a manual rescan.

items.title: Your definition of old or large
items.description: Choose the age and size thresholds that make sense for your files and workflow.

items.title: Check what’s inside likely duplicates
items.description: Use content hashes to verify likely matches after the initial filename and size checks.

items.title: Remember what you want to keep
items.description: Keep ignore decisions between reviews, so the same files do not keep asking for attention.

items.title: A focused, local file review
items.description: Group disk images, likely duplicates, older or larger files, and recent downloads from one selected folder.

items.title: Cleanup that waits for your decision
items.description: Move selected, unchanged files to Trash after confirmation. Trayage does not empty the Trash.

items.title: At home in your menu bar
items.description: A menu-bar popover, a full review window, and a choice to show Trayage in the Dock too.

items.title: Light, dark, or your Mac’s appearance
items.description: Choose the look that suits your workspace, with the same review controls in each appearance.
